vaparshop.title: Vapar Tools
vaparshop.subtitle: Designer & Developer
vaparshop.description: Led design and development initiatives for Vapar Tools retail operations and employee gamification ecosystem in Saint Petersburg.
vaparshop.challengeText: The retail stores operated with manual checkout logs, safe balance spreadsheets, and untracked customer objections, causing reporting delays and cash discrepancies.
vaparshop.solutionText: I developed a comprehensive Next.js 14 Telegram Mini App suite integrating GetMeBack loyalty scanning, shift life-cycles, automated manager alerts via Telegram bots, and an employee progress clicker game.

achievements.0: Shift closing times dropped by 40% with cash register safe discrepancies reduced to absolute zero

achievements.2: Employee engagement improved substantially through the built-in 14 HP progression clicker game
achievements.3: Manager manual oversight was cut in half by automated shift warning bot notifications
achievements.4: Daily objection category reporting provided actionable insights for retail inventory managers

priceTagPrinter.title: PRICE TAG PRINTER
priceTagPrinter.subtitle: Full-Stack Engineer
priceTagPrinter.description: Started as a pet project for a former employer, evolving into a production-ready API-first SaaS used by multiple retail companies.
priceTagPrinter.challengeText: Initially built to solve a specific problem at a company I worked for, where retail branches needed a scalable and error-free way to generate perfectly formatted price tags.
priceTagPrinter.solutionText: After leaving the company, I continued developing the project into a standalone product. Today, it's a robust API-first Next.js application with a custom theme engine, Zustand state management, and headless PDF rendering—adopted by multiple businesses.
priceTagPrinter.impactText: Fully automated generation pipeline natively supporting LLMs, Multi-Tier Pricing, and Headless PDFs.

achievements.0: Built a comprehensive REST API (`/api/generate-pdf`, `/api/themes`) with strictly typed OpenAPI documentation.
achievements.1: Engineered a Multi-Tier Pricing Engine supporting complex volume-based pricing discounts.
achievements.2: Created 17 pre-configured unified themes managed via a custom CVA (Class Variance Authority) component architecture.
achievements.3: Implemented a resilient data ingestion pipeline supporting XLSX parsing, Google Sheets APIs, and Clipboard imports.
achievements.4: Architected a scalable Zustand store with advanced history tracking (undo/redo) and persistence middleware.
achievements.5: Integrated an LLM pipeline to assist in generating natural language product descriptions directly on the tags.
achievements.6: Delivered a rock-solid UI using Shadcn, optimized edit tables, and real-time canvas preview systems.
achievements.7: Ensured enterprise-grade stability via Jest Unit Testing and structured Error Boundaries.
